+ [42] AXStaticText = "Homebrew-managed apps prefer Homebrew, with a choice to check other sources when it has no update. Apps installed in subfolders and through package receipts are matched more reliably, and unavailable registered apps are skipped during upgrades."

+ [44] AXStaticText = "TestFlight iPhone and iPad betas are checked for Mac compatibility before an update is offered. An incompatible build gets a warning, and a build whose compatibility cannot be confirmed stays unknown."
+ [45] AXStaticText = "TextMate, VimR, Maestro, muCommander and Shotcut now have update checks, one-click updates and release notes. Supported beta, snapshot and release-candidate tracks follow each app’s channel selection or installed release."
